Holiday train by Dolphin Nursery.verification: Viewed the official SeaWorld Orlando Christmas shows page on 23 November 2026. The image sits on the Holiday Trains card, with alt text Train, and the page text places this miniature Christmas train display right outside Dolphin Nursery at SeaWorld Orlando. Direct inspection shows a Santa Express locomotive numbered 19 pulling a red car of small trees on a trestle, with village lights around it. No people. No overlays or watermarks. The published file is 1256 by 508. It was cropped to 762 by 508 to keep the locomotive in a 3 by 2 frame, then sized to 1280 by 853. No freely licensed photo of this exact display was found. Miracles.note: November 23, 2026 official photo pass: SeaWorld Orlando published official Miracles stills on its homepage and Christmas shows page, including swomiraclesshow6-1-1.png (alt Miracles celebration) and swo-christmas-celebration-8-1.png, both showing an orca leaping at the Orlando stadium under a winter backdrop. Both published files are only 357 by 229, too small to make a sharp 1280 by 853 card without a heavy enlarge. The official 30 October 2026 press kit Box folder and its 60 second 1920 by 1080 b-roll package do not include a Miracles or orca stadium still. Official SeaWorld Orlando YouTube Christmas videos did not yield a usable high resolution still of this show. The official photos are the right subject at the right park, but an empty slot is kept until a sharp official still is available.
